content.title: 2023 Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Atrial Fibrillation

subtopics.subtopic: Prevent and Thromboembolism in the Setting of Cardioversion
subtopics.details: Focus on the use of transesophageal echocardiography for guidance during cardioversion in atrial fibrillation and the consideration of impaired mechanical function after electrical cardioversion.

details: Analysis of thromboembolic risks, particularly focusing on left atrial appendage occlusion and related anticoagulation strategies.
Assessment of different trials and studies regarding the efficacy and outcomes of various treatment protocols.

sections.details: Discussion on the technical implications of device-related thrombosis and complications following procedures like percutaneous left atrial appendage closure.

genes.context: 8.2.1. Prevention of Thromboembolism in the Setting of Cardioversion mentions genetic polymorphisms including CYP2C9 as important in anticoagulation management.
